purpose: Counterfactual controls on frozen real-source-derived structures; never re-adjudicate certified MAIN40 outcomes.
decision_semantics: least reconstruction-added structure required to restore the explicitly retained source-fidelity obligation after the declared ablation

remove_only: source-defined BG-selected action/CPG-parameter interface between BG result and cerebellar correction
retain_obligations: BG result + error -> cerebellum -> CPG correction
cerebellar fine-tuning must consume BG-selected action results

controls.evaluator_rule: If the source-defined mediator is absent but the cross-component typed transfer obligation is retained and no new persistent history is needed, direct A0 fails and the least repair is a reconstruction-added stateless typed interface.

remove_only: source-defined synaptic traces/tags as the delay-bridging eligibility state
retain_obligations: response-selection feedback contributes to tag formation
later reward/RPE gates plasticity at previously eligible synapses
the source temporal order explicitly states that traces/tags bridge delay

controls.evaluator_rule: If the source-defined history-bearing eligibility state is absent while delayed eligibility-dependent plasticity remains required, A0 fails; a present-input-only stateless repair cannot preserve the history dependence, so the least repair requires reconstruction-added persistent state.

guards: counterfactual controls are reported separately from empirical MAIN40 outcomes
no control frequency is interpreted as prevalence
